profile.reading: This record is 1 of 4 tightly clustered records in this registry attributed to Rowan Green Data LLC, all named Percheron DC, in Morrow County, Oregon, an area with substantial commercial data center development including a large Amazon build out. No corporate website could be reached for this operator this session, and no independent secondary source describing this specific campus was found, so address, capacity, and square footage remain not published in this record.
profile.research_note: [session addition 2026-09-03] This row was previously exhausted with no sourcing on file. WebSearch remains unavailable this session, which would normally be the next step for an operator with no reachable website. research_status left as exhausted, since this session could not reach a working operator source or a useful secondary source, and this row is left available for a future pass once WebSearch access is restored.
